## Executive Summary

Remediation cycle 1 resolves both in-scope findings from `code-review.2026-09-27T04-30.md`.

- **CR-1 (F1): RESOLVED.** A new constant `$script:TypographicQuoteCharacters` (U+2018, U+2019, U+201A, U+201B, U+201C, U+201D, U+201E) is checked with `IndexOfAny` in the existing early return of `Test-OrchestrationCommandTextUnresolvable` (line 131). Command text that contains any of these characters is therefore unresolvable before the single-quote `$`/backtick allowance (line 140) is evaluated. This is design R1, the fail-closed reading preferred by the coordinator ruling.
  - Three deny rows prove the fix on both runtimes: they failed before the fix and pass after.
  - A straight-single-quoted `$` remains admitted.
- **CR-3 (F2): RESOLVED.** The row-12 comment in `Test-ExemptOrchestrationStagingCommand` now states the current rule.
